summary: Charles Nelson Ditmore, 45, of Oakland, California, on a solo recreational snowmobile outing from a Browns Ranch home west of Telluride, became stuck in deep snow in a ravine near Paradox Road on the Uncompahgre Plateau Sunday afternoon; he spent all night digging his machine uphill a few feet at a time with a small collapsible shovel and was found safe and uninjured just before 1 p.m. Monday by a USFS law enforcement officer near Iron Springs Mesa.
location: Near Paradox Road, Iron Springs Mesa area, Uncompahgre Plateau
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff's Office SAR; USFS law enforcement; Helitrax helicopter
notes: Record date = search conclusion (found Monday 2016-01-04); stuck Sunday afternoon 2016-01-03. 911 call just before midnight Sunday; 13-hour overnight search including a private fixed-wing grid search and Helitrax helo (~3.5 air hours, ~100 mi); cell-phone pings failed after the battery died ~12:30 a.m. He had not told anyone his route. Surfaced via the San Miguel County SO alerts re-check (run 96).
